message.reasoning_content:
need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: The defendant (纪某) used his wife's name to fraudulently obtain land compensation payments from village committee. He provided false documents claiming his wife was a contract teacher (but she was a formal teacher, not eligible). He obtained 97000 RMB over multiple times. He later voluntarily surrendered, returned money.

This is fraud (诈骗) or specifically "诈骗罪" (fraud). Also could be "非法占有" but the typical charge is "诈骗罪". Could also be "职务侵占"? No, not a public official. It's a civil compensation scheme; he defrauded the village committee. So "诈骗" is appropriate.

Also maybe "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关证件、印章" because he used false documents? He used a teacher employment agreement to misrepresent status. That's not necessarily forging a state document; it's a false statement. Could be "伪造国家机关证件" but the teacher appointment is from education bureau, a government agency. He used the agreement to claim contract teacher status. He didn't forge the agreement; he used the real agreement but misrepresented. So not forging.

Thus only charge: 诈骗.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
